title: China Just Gave Away a $50B AI Model For Free — Here's Why That's Terrifying
description:
China just built the world's biggest open AI model.
But they're giving the whole thing away for free.
That's not kindness — that's strategy.
Kimi K3 already beats GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8 on coding tasks.
But Moonshot isn't racing to be the smartest.
It's racing to be everywhere first.
Free access means startups worldwide start building on Chinese AI instead of American AI.
The real AI war isn't about intelligence anymore — it's about who owns the infrastructure.

#kimik3 #china #ai #aitools
